comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: reuse the new `censusCount` helper in the remaining inline census normalizations**

gh-1196 introduces `censusCount(value)` (this line) to give the `Number(x || 0) || 0` census normalization one name — but the same idiom still appears inline in five untouched spots of this same module:

- `buildVerdictComment` — `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js:88` (`Number(record.blocking || 0) || 0`)
- `reconcileDecision` — `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js:359-360` (blocking + suggestions)
- `armReworkDecision` — `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js:396,400` (blocking + suggestions)

Those functions are outside this ticket's named scope, so leaving them is acceptable. A follow-up (or this PR, if trivial) swapping them for `censusCount(...)` would leave exactly one normalization definition in the module. Purely cosmetic consolidation — no behavior difference, no CRAP impact.
